name: Plant-Powered Kitchen: Vegan Meals Made Simple
description: Over 120 easy-to-follow vegan recipes showcase the versatility of vegetables, legumes, and grains. The book emphasizes nutrition, flavor balance, and quick weeknight meals, with pantry staples lists and meal-prep guides. Ideal for newcomers and seasoned vegans alike.
shortDescription: A simple, nutritious vegan cookbook with over 120 recipes.
